UI_FINISH_REQUESTED: Finish requested · no further investigation cycles
UI_DELIVERY_UNCONFIRMED: Research message delivery was not confirmed
UI_UNAUTHORIZED: This research action is not available to you.
UI_EXPIRED: This research action has expired. Use the latest status message.
UI_INVALID_INPUT: Invalid research input. Open the form again and enter up to 3000 characters.
RESEARCH_UNAVAILABLE: Research is not available in this conversation.
RESEARCH_COMMAND:
Prepare a deep research plan for this request using the research control tools.
{{request}}
RESEARCH_PARENT_UNAVAILABLE: Choose a completed research round in this thread as the reference.
RESEARCH_ROUND_ACTIVE: This thread already has an unfinished round. Read its status before proposing a plan.
RESEARCH_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE: This action is unavailable in the current state. Read the latest research status.
RESEARCH_CONFIRM_LATER: Show the plan and wait for confirmation in a later message or via Start.
RESEARCH_CONTINUE_LATER: Wait for an explicit user request after the limit was reached or use Continue.
RESEARCH_LIMIT_REACHED: 자동 실행 한도에 도달해 멈췄습니다. 저장된 자료와 보고서는 유지됩니다. Continue로 추가 조사하거나 Finish로 현재 자료를 최종 정리할 수 있습니다.
RESEARCH_CHANGED: Research changed. Use the latest status message.
RESEARCH_CANCELLED: 조사를 취소했습니다. 새 조사 계획을 만들 수 있습니다.
RESEARCH_EXPORT_STOPPED: Canvas 저장을 멈췄습니다. 완료 보고서는 유지되며 추가 조사나 저장을 다시 진행할 수 있습니다.
RESEARCH_FINISHING: 현재 조사 단계가 끝나면 추가 탐색 없이 검토와 최종 작성을 진행합니다.
RESEARCH_NO_FINAL: Complete the report before saving it to Canvas.
RESEARCH_INPUT_LIMIT: Provide research details using up to 16000 characters.
RESEARCH_PAUSE_TO_EDIT: Pause the research before editing its scope.
RESEARCH_DETAILS_LIMIT: Research details are too long. Start a new Slack thread.
RESEARCH_UPDATES_LIMIT: Too many scope updates. Pause and edit the research brief.
RESEARCH_UPDATE_SAVED: 추가 내용을 저장했습니다. 다음 조사 단계부터 반영합니다.
RESEARCH_CLARIFICATION_UPDATED: 추가 내용을 반영해 조사 범위를 정리하고 있습니다. 준비되면 Start 버튼이 표시됩니다.
RESEARCH_INTERRUPTED: Research was interrupted. Resume to continue using the saved materials.
RESEARCH_OUTPUT_INVALID: Invalid {{kind}} result. Resume to retry this stage.
RESEARCH_SCOPE_LIMIT: Research scope is too long. Shorten it with Edit.
RESEARCH_STALLED: {{provider}} stopped after no execution events. Resume to retry.
RESEARCH_REPORT_PARTIAL: 표시 길이 제한으로 보고서 일부만 표시했습니다. Save to Canvas로 전체 보고서를 저장할 수 있습니다.
RESEARCH_REPORT_UNCONFIRMED: Report delivery is uncertain. Use Save to Canvas to read the saved report.
RESEARCH_USE_CONTROLS: Use Pause or Resume on the research status message.
RESEARCH_CANVAS_BLOCK_LIMIT: A report block exceeds the Canvas content limit. The saved report is unchanged.
RESEARCH_CANVAS_UNCERTAIN: Canvas delivery is uncertain. Read and reconcile it before retrying export.
RESEARCH_CANVAS_UNVERIFIED: Canvas accepted the content, but its revision could not be verified. Do not append again.
RESEARCH_CANVAS_CHANGED: The exported Canvas was edited. Review it before continuing export.
